### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. When comparing a full IEC61970 model I'm always frustrated when [...]

### Describe the solution you'd like:

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen: for the report, what it should show or let you do; for the command line, what cim-compare should produce.

### Describe alternatives you've considered:

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional context:

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. Include links to example reports ([cim-compare.ucaiug.io](https://cim-compare.ucaiug.io/)), external sites and information that may be useful as reference for the feature or enhancement.
